modules.name: Hero with photos
modules.description: Big opening screen with the shop's own photos (or a generated pattern if none), name, tagline and a Book button.

modules.name: Services & price list
modules.description: Categories, durations, 'from' prices, who it's for (women/men/children) and hair types. Filter chips for customers.

modules.name: Online booking request
modules.description: Customer picks a service, stylist (or anyone) and a time inside opening hours. The shop confirms it in the admin page. Includes an 'add to calendar' (.ics) file. With no always-on server, the same form sends the request by WhatsApp instead (it says clearly that this is a request, not a booking).

modules.name: Stylist / barber profiles
modules.description: Photo (optional), role, short bio and specialities for each team member.

modules.name: Gallery
modules.description: The shop's own photos of work and the salon.

modules.name: Reviews + 'leave a Google review'
modules.description: Shows reviews the owner copies in (with where they came from) and a button to Google's own write-a-review page for the shop. Needs the shop's Google place ID, no key.

modules.name: WhatsApp, call and directions buttons
modules.description: Sticky buttons on the phone screen: WhatsApp chat, call, and directions in the customer's map app.

modules.name: Opening hours
modules.description: Week view with 'open now' and special closed dates.

modules.name: Location map
modules.description: OpenStreetMap map of the shop (from the postcode) with a directions link.

modules.name: Offers banner
modules.description: One line offer at the top, switched on/off from the admin page.

modules.name: Multi-language (incl. right-to-left)
modules.description: Up to four languages; Arabic, Farsi, Urdu, Pashto and Kurdish (Sorani) show right-to-left. Screen words are drafted for English, Romanian, Polish, Arabic, Turkish, Urdu and French and should be checked by a native speaker.

modules.name: Install to home screen
modules.description: Works as an app on the phone (PWA) and shows saved info when offline.

modules.name: Owner admin page
modules.description: Password-protected page to edit everything, switch modules on/off and see bookings. Keys are stored on the shop's computer only and never exported.

modules.name: Deposits / pay online
modules.description: Ask for a deposit when booking (per service, or after a no-show). The time is HELD for 10 minutes while the client pays. Paid in time = confirmed; declined or no answer = released. A payment that arrives late is re-checked: if the time has gone, it is marked 'refund due' and the owner is alerted. Payment firms: Stripe, Square or SumUp (the owner's own account and key). The owner can also mark a deposit paid by hand. With no firm connected, the booking becomes a request and the shop takes the deposit itself.
parts: Owner's own fixed pay link per service
Held slot, expiry, late-payment re-check, refund alert
Owner marks deposit paid by hand

modules.name: Automated booking (per-stylist availability)
modules.description: Customers see real free times for each stylist (their own days, hours, breaks and days off) and are confirmed instantly, or held for a deposit. Double bookings are impossible: checked under one lock on one server. Handles clean-up buffers, flexible breaks for long services, and processing time (a stylist can do a quick trim while a colour develops).

modules.name: Reminders (WhatsApp / SMS)
modules.description: Reminders ready to send the day before at the same London clock time (right across the clock changes). One tap opens WhatsApp with the message filled in. With a Twilio key they can go as SMS from the admin page. Nothing is sent without the owner pressing send.

modules.name: Google Calendar sync
modules.description: Puts confirmed bookings into the salon's Google Calendar. Until keys are added, every booking has a free .ics 'add to calendar' file.

modules.name: Fresha / Treatwell / Booksy links
modules.description: Buttons that open the shop's own page on these booking platforms. Link-out only: none of them offers a public booking API we could verify (Fresha states no public API; Treatwell and Booksy partner APIs not verified).

cost_notes.text: Price not checked — each platform charges its own fees.

modules.name: Loyalty stamp card
modules.description: e.g. every 6th visit free. Each card has a code; customers can check their stamps in the app.

modules.name: Gift vouchers
modules.description: Issue vouchers with a code and balance, spend over several visits, customers check the balance in the app. Selling online uses the Deposits pay link if switched on.

modules.name: Memberships & packages
modules.description: Prepaid bundles like '5 beard trims' or a monthly blow-dry club, with visits counted down.

modules.name: Product shop (retail hair products)
modules.description: Sell shampoos, oils and styling products: stock counts, low-stock warnings, barcode lookup (Open Beauty Facts, free, no key), reserve by WhatsApp or pay link.

modules.name: Walk-in queue board
modules.description: Customers join from their phone or at the counter. Waits are worked out from each person's own service time and any booked appointments in the same chairs. A free barber calls the first person they can serve. Skipped once = back 2 places; twice = off the list. One place per phone; joining stops when it would finish after closing. The big screen shows first names only; a phone that loses signal shows its last answer and when it was checked.

modules.name: Before / after gallery
modules.description: Side-by-side photos. The owner must tick that the client agreed to the photo being shown.

modules.name: Client notes, allergy & patch-test record
modules.description: Private notes per client, allergies and patch tests with retest dates. Kept on the shop's own computer only; allergy details need the client's consent tick (UK GDPR special category data). Export or erase a client on request. When on, services marked 'needs patch test' can only be booked if a clear patch test is recorded at least 48 hours before (the owner sets the gap).

modules.name: Staff rota & commission tracker
modules.description: Weekly shifts per person and commission at the rates the owner sets, from takings entered or completed bookings.

modules.name: Review requests after a visit
modules.description: When a booking is marked done, a ready message with the Google review link: WhatsApp tap-to-send, or SMS with a Twilio key.

modules.name: Instagram / TikTok links
modules.description: Buttons to the shop's own Instagram and TikTok pages (no feed embedding, no login).

modules.name: Referral codes
modules.description: Give a client a code to share; new clients enter it when booking; the owner sees who to reward.

modules.name: Multi-branch
modules.description: More than one address, each with its own hours and team; customers choose the branch when booking.

modules.name: Accessibility options
modules.description: Customer buttons for bigger text, high contrast and less motion, plus the owner's access info (step-free, quiet appointments…).

modules.name: Cancellation policy / no-show fee text
modules.description: The shop's policy shown at booking with a tick box. Text only; charging a fee needs the Deposits module.

modules.name: Analytics dashboard (local counts)
modules.description: Counts of app opens, booking requests and button taps per day, kept on the shop's computer. No cookies, no personal data.

modules.name: Supplier finder (salon wholesalers)
modules.description: Live web and map search for hair and beauty wholesalers near the shop (OpenStreetMap shop=hairdresser_supply). Every result is labelled 'found live, not checked by us'.

services.label: Processing time (optional), e.g. 45 active, 45 processing, 30 active

staff.label: Break can move during long services (3 hours+)

before_after.label: Client agreed to these photos being shown

reviews.label: Name as shown on the review

products.label: Warn when stock is at or below

status_key.code-ready-needs-key: Code written against the firm's official documents; needs the owner's own key; not run here against the real service.
status_key.link-only: Opens the shop's own page elsewhere; no data is exchanged.
status_key.needs-server: Only works while the shop's app server is running (hosted or on a shop PC). Without one, the app falls back to a WhatsApp request.
